## 下載
`brew install ipfs`
`ipfs init`
```js
import { create } from 'ipfs-http-client'
const ipfs = create(new URL('http://127.0.0.1:5001'))
const { cid } = await ipfs.add('Hello world!')
//CID(QmQzCQn4puG4qu8PVysxZmscmQ5vT1ZXpqo7f58Uh9QfyY)
```
